g.text: Well, now I have the answer to why you're hanging around here so much.
When you could simply just go back to the future and stay there.
I know I've left you hanging, while I've tried to sort things out. But given our situation, I think I had every right to take some time.
I'm happy for you and Aoi.
I suppose I'm surprised, is all.
I'm happy for you and Eleanor.
I figured you didn't have feelings for me in return.
Yeah, well, I got sick of waiting.
You're the one I *really* have feelings for.
She deserves peace. I hope you can bring her some.
I'm happy for you and Amir.
I know you and Aoi used to be more than friends...
I'll do my best not to screw this up.
What if I said my relationship was a lie, and I have feelings for you?
He could use the confidence having a partner can bring.
I'm happy for you and Quincy.
So, do you just go about confessing your feelings to everybody and seeing who bites the lure?
I know you and Aoi are friends.
Deplorable. Stringing someone along like that - someone who trusts you?
He needs to learn to let someone in now and then.
I'm happy for you and Lettie.
But I'm happy for you and Aoi.
Sad, maybe. Watching you make her happy in a way I never could.
I'll do you a favour and keep this between us, mate - in hopes that this is your dark sense of humor showing up again.
She needs someone she can share the pain with. Not just physical, either.
If any one of us idiots deserve to be happy, it's her.
But I'm happy for you and Eleanor.
Or are your feelings for Aoi *actually* legitimate?
But that's the thing. She's happy when she's with you.
If there's one of us knobheads that deserves to be happy, it's her.
You can forget about anything ever happening between us. We can stay friends, but that's all it'll be.
I'll do my best not to screw this up.
What if I said my relationship was a lie, and I still had feelings for you?
She deserves peace. I hope you can bring her some.
But I'm happy for you and Amir.
Because if any of us deserve to be happy, it's her.
Or are your feelings for Eleanor *actually* legitimate?
So, do me a favour, if you could? Try not to break her heart if you can help it.
He could use the confidence having a partner can bring.
But I'm happy for you and Quincy.
My relationship is real. I promise.
No, it's you I really have feelings for... I just gave up hope.
Because if you hurt her, I'm not responsible if she decides to scramble your brain.
Or are your feelings for Amir *actually* legitimate?
He needs to learn to let someone in now and then.
But I'm happy for you and Lettie.
I sincerely hope so. For all our sakes.
So you're just stringing them along?!
The last thing that man needs is to have his confidence in himself shaken again.
Or are your feelings for Quincy *actually* legitimate?
She needs someone she can share the pain with. Not just physical, either.
I mean, I can have feelings for more than one person.
That man doesn't let people in. You screw that up, it might be the last time he does.
Or are your feelings for Lettie *actually* legitimate?
Sure, but I can't. And I'm not comfortable with this.
Because she hurts enough without you adding onto the pile, mate.
